note: EXTRACTED from docs/109-fiddlers-gulch-lines.md (THE CHANGES IN CONSOLATION) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 109 and re-run.

LOOK_AT.say: My copy of the survey, the third, in Mr. Sump's own hand: 'Commencing at the stake, thereabouts; thence uphill, with feeling…'
repeat: '…to the larger of the two rocks; thence along the line the rod preferred, some forty feet, until the humming stopped; thence home.'
Mr. Sump says no applicant ever asked for the third copy. I'm the first. I may frame it.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper, crisp. Nobody's folded it before me.
repeat: It crackles. It's the best-kept thing I own.
Quiet. It's official now. It doesn't need to say anything.
